title: A plain Opus ask grants Opus to the task it names: the agents spawned for it, plus resumes and retries of those agents
ruling: Owner 14:21 CST Nov 13, relayed by the retrospective, on page item 761 option d: "agreed". Before that, 14:18: "oh my version is too generous and yours is too tight there's an optimal middle ground though if you thinka bout it". Meaning (option d as posted): a plain Opus ask grants Opus to the agents spawned for that ask, in the turn he typed it, plus resumes or retries of those same agents by name; role-scoped if the ask names a role ("opus reviewers"); the grant ends when those agents end. `opus <time>` stays timed; `opus off` ends any grant. REWRITES in place the Opus-ask half of item 601 a (12:54 CST Nov 12, "an Opus ask with no length lasts until the session ends or `opus off`"); the override half of 601 a (a one-act override ends on use, `override off` or his next typed message) stands. Draft #2928 builds the old reading and needs re-pointing (coordinator).
quote: agreed (on option d, 14:21 CST) | too generous ... too tight ... optimal middle ground (14:18 CST)
